units.source_text: 但是到了第二年，阿民依然早出晚归，天天忙着干农务，其他的事情都不愿意想。

en.t: But when the second year came, Amin still went out early and came home late, busy with farm work every day and unwilling to think about anything else.

units.source_text: 阿住比去年更加殷勤的劝说阿民招赘的事儿，主要是因为受到亲戚们的责备和邻居们的闲话影响，她有苦难言。

en.t: Azhu urged Amin even more earnestly than the previous year to take a husband into the family, mainly because she was under pressure from her relatives' reproaches and the neighbors' gossip, leaving her with a bitterness she could not speak of.
